title: Router sensitivity under realistic requantization -- O003 (Kimi-VL, DeepSeek-V3-style sigmoid/noaux_tc router, 6/64+2 shared)
_evidence: SYNTHESIZED from receipts/odyssey-i/O003_SENSITIVITY.json's per_organ_sensitivity (already MEASURED, in-place mlx ablation, canonical HF snapshot untouched; baseline 12/12). No new measurement -- this is disk-only rule-testing of existing evidence, per S003's 'transfer-rule extraction' / 'receipt analysis' guidance.

discriminator.claim: R-protect-router-if-sensitive's condition ('router sensitivity high') is testable by comparing round8 (realistic quantization-grade perturbation, near-identity round-trip on an already-4bit organ) delta_hits across organs -- zero (destructive full-ablation) is NOT the test, since it breaks every organ equally and says nothing about ROUTER specifically.
discriminator.finding: Under round8, router loses 0/12 battery hits (robust); embed/attn/expert/shared_expert each lose 1/12 (measurably sensitive); mlp_dense/norm/lm_head also 0 (robust). The rule's own precondition ('router sensitivity high') is EMPIRICALLY FALSE for O003 -- its DeepSeek-V3-style router (sigmoid/noaux_tc gating, 6/64 experts + 2 shared, 26 router modules) tolerates a realistic 8-bit round-trip with zero measured degradation on a 12-item capability battery.

rule_update.verdict_for_O003: CONDITION NOT MET -- not a confirmation or refutation of the THEN clause, but the first real measurement of the rule's own IF clause. Moves the rule from pure HYPOTHESIS (0 supporting_patients, never checked against a real router) to MEASURED-AND-CONDITIONAL: router sensitivity is NOT universal -- it must be measured per architecture/routing-mechanism, not assumed. The rule's physical_rationale ('cheap to keep precise, expensive if it is wrong') is now known to be FALSE for at least one real sigmoid/noaux_tc router: wrong costs nothing measurable here.
rule_update.gravity_decision_changed: For O003-family (DeepSeek-V3-style sigmoid MoE routers), do NOT spend extra bit-budget protecting router precision -- the measured-sensitive organs (embed/attn/expert/shared_expert) are the actual quantization-error-preserving budget targets. This is the OPPOSITE allocation from what the rule's untested HYPOTHESIS would have recommended.
